hotels.title: Switzerland Trendy City Break in Zurich with Outdoor Pool & Wellness Area
hotels.description: Step into a world where contemporary design meets Zurich’s creative pulse, set in the vibrant district of Zurich West. Sport-themed interiors, vibrant colours and playful touches create a unique atmosphere throughout the hotel, just steps from the city’s trendsetting boutiques and the celebrated Freitag Tower. Make the most of the excellent onsite facilities, including a heated 25-metre pool, yoga and wellness area and a complimentary co-working space. When it's time to indulge, savour Mediterranean flavours at Ribelli restaurant or explore the neighbourhood’s renowned culinary scene, including Frau Gerolds Garten and the city's riverside restaurants.

hotels.title: Switzerland Trendy Zurich West City Break with Lavish Health Club
hotels.description: Immerse yourself in Zurich's lakeside beauty with an opulent stay at Crowne Plaza Zurich, an IHG Hotel - ideally positioned within the vibrant Zurich West District. Within this stylish hotel you will discover an expansive health club, a glittering pool and two sumptuous eateries. Beyond the hotel, find yourself in the heart of the global centre for banking and finance where picturesque cobblestone lanes, pre-medieval architecture and the twinkling Lake Zurich awaits.
